description.zh_cn: 韧性升级，强韧兼顾，高精度低收缩，色彩饱满，适合打印受力结构件。

description.en: Upgraded toughness, balanced strength and toughness, high precision with low shrinkage, vibrant colors, ideal for printing load-bearing structural parts.

description.kr: Upgraded toughness, balanced strength and toughness, high precision with low shrinkage, vibrant colors, ideal for printing load-bearing structural parts.

description.zh_cn: 高强度，高韧性，可水洗，低气味，易成型，易拆支撑，适合打印受力结构件。

description.en: High strength, high toughness, washable, low odor, easy to mold, and easy to remove supports, ideal for printing load-bearing structural parts.

description.kr: High strength, high toughness, washable, low odor, easy to mold, and easy to remove supports, ideal for printing load-bearing structural parts.

description.zh_cn: 生物相容性，固化后的模型可与人体皮肤接触而不过敏，低气味，强韧平衡，适合打印硅胶覆模零件。

description.kr: Biocompatibility, cured models can come into contact with skin without causing allergies, low odor, balanced strength and toughness, ideal for printing silicone overmolding parts.

description.zh_cn: 可DIY调色，官方出具调色表与用户共创表，可支持100+颜色调试。

description.en: DIY color-mixable, with official color mixing charts and user co-creation charts, supporting over 100 color combinations.

description.kr: DIY color-mixable, with official color mixing charts and user co-creation charts, supporting over 100 color combinations.

description.zh_cn: 超高精度，无像素纹，收缩小，适合打印表现细节要求较高的手办模型。

description.kr: Ultra-high precision, no pixelation, low shrinkage, ideal for printing figure models with high-detail requirements.

description.kr: Low odor, ultra-low viscosity, ultra-fast printing speed, and significantly improved toughness compared to the first generation, ideal for rapid printing of large cosplay props with low precision requirements.
